title: Implement checkpoint and restart recovery vertical slice

implementation.checkpoint_manifest: CheckpointManifest is canonical-JSON serialized, published to the evidence CAS before the immutable checkpoint-integrity row, and binds canonical Plan IR, compiler provenance, task/attempt runtimes, repository snapshot/diff, evidence/dependency/output bindings, current action records, process leases, journal sequence, and execution epoch.
implementation.integrity_and_ancestry: Recovery runs bounded SQLite integrity checks, verifies checkpoint CAS digests, walks only explicit trusted hash/recovery-anchor ancestry, falls back to an older manifest-valid trusted checkpoint, preserves corrupt physical rows for audit, and appends a recovery re-anchor from the exact trusted generation/hash.
implementation.authoritative_replay: Controller task/attempt state changes are persisted atomically with runtime-bound journal payloads. Recovery replays ordered post-checkpoint runtime payloads from the trusted manifest and requires exact equality with current SQLite. Baseline/plan-validity drift is accepted only when the latest relevant post-checkpoint transition exactly binds the current snapshot/diff/validity.
implementation.intent_exactness: Pre-mutation recovery uses a checkpoint-bound persisted action intent, revalidates plan/task/origin-attempt/repository/path/source/old/new/postimage/mode bindings, re-derives the prior action identity/nonce from the exact semantics, and refuses post-recovery semantic tampering.
implementation.no_model_or_edit_replay: A pre-mutation crash resumes the exact durable intent without another model call; a committed edit resumes deterministic verification only; an ambiguous dispatched side effect becomes unknown/reconciling and cannot be replayed.
implementation.process_recovery: ProcessRunner persists a pending_spawn ownership lease before spawn, upgrades it to PGID + leader PID/birth identity after spawn, and recovery reaps only when exact identity is proven; identity-less, PID-reused, or escaped/unproven descendants remain mutation-blocking.
implementation.epoch_and_unknown: Recovery advances execution_epoch monotonically to invalidate stale leases/authorizations, reconciles historical actions under their original epoch through recovery-only transitions, and readiness consults current action state rather than historical unknown events.
implementation.plan_boundary: Recovery reconstructs privately from the durable canonical plan while public activation remains owned opaque PlanCompilationResult only. Superseded plan checkpoints remain blocked without explicit N+1 carry-forward validation.
implementation.t09_boundary: T08 contains no second repair model attempt and does not recompile/replan a valid durable plan; actual targeted repair remains M1-T09.

completion_evidence.crash_matrix: 17/17 deterministic crash/restart scenarios pass on current source
completion_evidence.state_transition_guarantee: task/attempt transitions and recovery normalization bind exact resulting runtime records into the same SQLite transaction as the journal event; fallback recovery replays those ordered payloads and compares exact final state
completion_evidence.checkpoint_chain: CAS-backed manifests plus immutable checkpoint rows, trusted-ancestry fallback, and recovery re-anchor are exercised including corrupt hash tail and missing re-anchor CAS object
completion_evidence.action_replay_safety: committed edits are never dispatched again; ambiguous dispatched side effects block; exact pre-mutation intent survives two recoveries without a second model call
completion_evidence.process_ownership: pending_spawn pre-spawn lease and PID/PGID/birth-safe recovery are exercised; identity-less window remains blocked
